# Run this schedule with RINGOUT_ROLLBACK_HORIZON_FRAMES=1. The live scheduler
# conservatively permits one predicted SI batch per horizon frame, so holding
# all redundant copies beyond that batch must stall. The sender keeps running
# and releases the retained packets at ordinal 37, so the frozen peer resumes.
delay 32 37
delay 33 37
delay 34 37
delay 35 37
